heroSummary: Spokane Public Schools begins its second balanced-calendar year with K–12 Launch Conferences on August 23–24. Grades 1–12 begin classes on August 25, 2027, when kindergarten also begins its A/B rotation; all kindergarten students attend together on August 27. The calendar keeps school breaks in October and February, with the last day scheduled for June 15, 2028.
calendarNotes: K–12 Launch Conferences run August 23–24. Grades 1–12 begin classes August 25, when kindergarten also begins its A/B rotation; all kindergarten students attend together August 27. SPS has not yet published separate 2027–28 preschool program start dates, so this page does not carry forward dates from 2026–27. The second 180-day balanced calendar retains an October 18–22 break and a February 22–25 break in addition to Winter and Spring Break. Most instructional Mondays begin one hour late for staff collaboration, with holiday and break Mondays removed from the pattern. PLID non-student days occur October 8 and March 17, while January 27–28 are marked as elementary conferences. June 16 and June 20 are separate conditional weather make-up dates after the June 15 scheduled last day, with the June 19 Juneteenth holiday between them.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2026–27
content: Grades 1–12 begin August 25, one day earlier than in 2026–27. Kindergarten A/B rotation also begins August 25, and all kindergarten students attend together August 27.
The October school break shifts to October 18–22, and the February break shifts to February 22–25 after Presidents Day.
The PDF no longer lists separate PreK, AM/PM, CIP, or SSP preschool opening and ending dates.
Weather reserves change from a June 21–22 block to separate June 16 and June 20 dates around Juneteenth.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Spokane Public Schools start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–12 begin Wednesday, August 25, 2027, after K–12 Launch Conferences August 23–24. Kindergarten A/B rotation also begins August 25, and all kindergarten students attend together August 27.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Spokane kindergarten students start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Kindergarten A/B rotation begins August 25, 2027. All kindergarten students attend together Friday, August 27.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the SPS 2027–28 calendar list preschool start dates?
calendarFaqs.a: No. SPS has not yet published separate 2027–28 preschool program start dates. Check the district's preschool information closer to the start of the school year.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spokane Public Schools' October break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The balanced-calendar October break runs October 18–22, 2027. Students return Monday, October 25 on the late-start collaboration schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spokane Public Schools' February break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The balanced-calendar February break runs February 22–25, 2028, immediately after Presidents Day on February 21. Students return Monday, February 28.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for SPS in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day is Thursday, June 15, 2028. June 16 and June 20 are separate conditional weather make-up dates, with Juneteenth on June 19 between them.
No. SPS describes 2027–28 as a 180-day balanced calendar that keeps summer vacation while adding school breaks in October and February.

calendarFaqs.q: Are SPS weather make-up days automatically school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. June 16 and June 20 fall after the scheduled June 15 last day and become attendance days only if Spokane Public Schools activates them.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 8, 2026, using SPS's current school-year and balanced-calendar pages, preschool information, and the 2027–28 year-at-a-glance PDF currently linked by the district.
sourceReviewDetails: The current 2027–28 PDF was rendered and checked visually because colors and symbols distinguish late starts, holidays, school breaks, conferences, PLID days, first or last days, and weather reserves.
The PDF currently linked by SPS lists K–12 Launch Conferences August 23–24, grades 1–12 and kindergarten A/B rotation beginning August 25, and all kindergarten students attending together August 27.
SPS's balanced-calendar page confirms that this model contains 180 instructional days and is not year-round school.
SPS has not yet published separate 2027–28 preschool program start dates. The page leaves them unpublished rather than carrying forward 2026–27 dates.
The late-start Monday dates were transcribed from the gray calendar cells and grouped in one guide.
June 16 and June 20 are two separate weather reserves; June 19 is the Juneteenth holiday, so the page does not present one continuous make-up range.
